subject.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends

question: Should this PR land the Signal-only `replyToId` alias and bounded group reply-author persistence without live Signal device proof on the latest head?
rationale: The code stays within the Signal plugin boundary and has focused tests plus green exact-head CI, but persisted sender metadata and native message-delivery behavior are compatibility choices automation should not finalize.

options.title: Accept Signal-Scoped Contract
options.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance because the branch is Signal-scoped, exact-head checks are green, and the remaining risk is intentional ownership of alias and bounded state behavior.

options.title: Require Live Signal Smoke
options.body: Hold merge until a maintainer-run Signal daemon/device round trip proves native visual quote rendering on the latest head.

options.title: Pause For Broader Quote Direction
options.body: Pause or close only if maintainers want the broader bidirectional quote-reply strategy to replace this focused branch.

recommendation.title: Accept Signal-Scoped Contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance because the branch is Signal-scoped, exact-head checks are green, and the remaining risk is intentional ownership of alias and bounded state behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the broadest recent ownership of the affected Signal/channel delivery paths, while the decision is about merge risk rather than author follow-up.
